name: Agent readiness and collection
description: Define the launch, readiness, prompt, completion, collection, and stop contract for one provider adapter.

variants.description: Use a local worker process that implements the same readiness and structured completion protocol as an agent adapter.
setup: Create a run-owned workspace and a deterministic worker fixture that emits READY with the run nonce.
Start the completion listener before launching the worker.
exercise: Launch the worker through the provider-adapter interface, wait for its nonce-tagged readiness signal, and submit a structured request.
Wait for the completion event and collect the worker's JSON result from the owned surface.

assertions.expectation: No task is dispatched before the exact run-scoped READY signal is observed.
The result contains the expected schema, run nonce, request ID, and deterministic payload.
Readiness and completion use bounded signals rather than fixed sleep-based success criteria.
The worker and its Cmux resources are gone without changing unrelated resources.

cleanup: Gracefully stop the fixture worker or close its run-owned surface on timeout.
Close the run workspace, remove artifacts, and compare against the baseline tree.

variants.description: Run the same protocol through one selected real provider using a read-only prompt.
setup: Select one installed provider, confirm read-only permissions, and create a disposable repository with no secrets.
Create a run-owned surface and start the provider-specific readiness and completion listeners.
exercise: Launch the provider adapter, wait for readiness, and ask it to return a nonce-tagged structured observation without editing files.
Collect the structured artifact and the bounded terminal evidence after completion.

assertions.expectation: The provider reaches readiness before dispatch and within its adapter-specific deadline.
The disposable repository has no content or metadata changes after the agent turn.
The collected artifact contains the run nonce and request ID; exact prose is not scored.
The live provider process and every run-owned Cmux resource are removed.

cleanup: Request a graceful provider exit, then close the owned surface if it misses the bounded stop deadline.
Remove the disposable repository and prove the unrelated Cmux baseline is unchanged.
